newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes higher again.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes higher again.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index rose again on Thursday pushed by late gains from SPT Telecom during the continuous trading session.
The PX50 gained 0.8 percent to 551.4 while the major issue dominated RPIX rose one percent to 1,155.4.
Despite the gains, dealers again warned that activity was too low to inspire confidence that Czech equities may be about to turn the corner after several weeks of declines.
"The volumes are thin and there's very low foreign participation. It goes back to the same old problem of thinness on the market," said Jan Sykora of Wood and Company.
SPT Telecom spearheaded Thursday's gains with a 44 crown rise to 3,494. Power utility CEZ rose 15 crowns to 1,075 and Komercni Banka moved 16 crowns higher to 2,312.
On Thursday, the central bank announced that it would be cutting minimum reserve requirements for commercial banks to 9.5 percent from 11.5 percent but interest rates were left unchanged.
